The test image shows a corn leaf with scattered small, circular/oval tan-cream spots with some darker borders, plus a few very small black dots. The midrib area shows some lesion. Key features: small circular spots, scattered distribution, some appearing water-soaked.

Top candidates: Eyespot (small circular spots with halos), Tar Spot (black spots), Physoderma Brown Spot, Holcus Spot.

Let me view reference images one at a time.

Eyespot reference shows many small circular yellow/tan spots with halos - similar pattern to test image but more yellow/golden colored. The test image spots appear more tan/cream/white. Let me check Tar Spot.
Tar Spot shows predominantly black raised spots - doesn't match the test image's cream/tan spots. Let me check Holcus Spot.
Holcus Spot shows large single oval spots - not matching the test image's many small scattered spots. Let me check Physoderma Brown Spot.
Physoderma Brown Spot shows small scattered spots plus dark lesions along the midrib - this matches the test image's pattern closely! Let me view another Physoderma reference.
This is the stalk version. Let me check Eyespot more carefully and one more candidate.

Eyespot shows yellow ring-like halos - the test image spots don't have that distinct ring pattern. The Physoderma Brown Spot reference (47) with scattered spots + midrib lesions still best matches. Let me check one more candidate - Carbonum Leaf Spot.

Carbonum shows larger elongated spots - doesn't match the test image's many small circular spots.

**Summary:**
- Test image: small circular tan/cream spots scattered across leaf blade, a few black dots, midrib lesion
- Eyespot: ring-shaped yellow halos - slightly different color/pattern
- Tar Spot: predominantly black raised spots - doesn't match cream spots
- Holcus Spot: large single oval lesions - doesn't match
- Physoderma Brown Spot (ref 47): scattered small spots across leaf blade + dark lesions along midrib - closely matches the test image's dual feature of scattered cream spots AND midrib discoloration
- Carbonum Leaf Spot: larger elongated spots - doesn't match

The test image's combination of scattered small tan/cream spots on the leaf blade plus dark midrib lesions is the hallmark of Physoderma Brown Spot.
